title: The Falling Knife Trap (5 Stocks Smart Investors Are Buying Instead)
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat's Bridget hosts Joseph Hogue of Let's Talk Money! on the 'falling knife trap': instead of averaging down into beaten-down stocks, he argues for momentum investing - UCLA research shows 3-12 month winners keep winning - filtered for quality fundamentals. He names five momentum stocks with strong fundamentals. Cloudflare (NET, +15% past month, +78% past year): ahead of the AI threat with a usage-based model, 20% of the global internet in front of its network, cross-selling security tools, and an edge-computing advantage. Datadog (DDOG, +6% month): 'the next Palantir' - enterprise observability now layering AI via its February Sekona AI partnership, ~20% revenue growth expected with accelerating earnings leverage next year. Palo Alto Networks (PANW, +3% month): the largest cybersecurity player, misunderstood on the AI threat, with 15-20% operating margins and trading at ~11x sales, its cheapest in five years - Bridget calls it the most compelling entry and adds it to her paper watchlist. Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO): the safety pick - outperforming a battered healthcare-equipment sector, turning 5.2% sales growth into 7.3% earnings growth, trading at 3.9x sales (a ~28.5% discount to its norm). AT&T (T, 3.9% dividend): recession-proof telecom oligopoly, levering 2.3% sales growth into 8.5% earnings growth - 'pays you to wait.' No MarketBeat (Bridget) calls - all stock calls are the guest's (host-only). Note: 'NetApp Cloudflare' garble - NET is Cloudflare; CrowdStrike, Fortinet, Zscaler, Verizon mentioned with no explicit calls.
